text.aria-label: Title text 'The spread of school-term effects across Primaries is smaller than the seed noise. Orange dot: school-term minus shuffled-day placebo (1 seed each). Bar: 95% 5-month interval. Grey cross: plain M0 seed 0 minus seed 1 (pure noise). All rows. Interim.'
text.tspan: The spread of school-term effects across Primaries is smaller than the seed noise.
Orange dot: school-term minus shuffled-day placebo (1 seed each). Bar: 95% 5-month interval.
Grey cross: plain M0 seed 0 minus seed 1 (pure noise). All rows. Interim.
